raw_text: Sri Lanka's economic recovery under the IMF Extended Fund Facility faces a major setback as widespread protests against austerity conditions paralyse Colombo. The government's decision to raise VAT to 18% and eliminate fuel subsidies has triggered public anger. Economists warn that without completing the IMF program, Sri Lanka risks losing access to its $2.9 billion bailout package.
clean_text: Sri Lanka IMF recovery faces setback as protests paralyse Colombo. VAT raised to 18%, fuel subsidies eliminated. Risk of losing $2.9B bailout.
